description.value: Haveli Indian Bistro is a casual sit-down Indian restaurant in Surrey serving a broad menu of traditional appetizers, tandoori dishes, biryanis, and Indo-Chinese fusion fare made with fresh, locally sourced ingredients. The restaurant offers dine-in, takeout, and online ordering, and also operates a full catering service for weddings, corporate events, and private parties. With a 4.2-star rating and a party hall on-site, it functions as both a neighbourhood dining destination and an event venue.
